title: 1954 AHSME Problem 50
statement: The times between \(7\) and \(8\) o’clock, correct to the nearest minute, when the hands of a clock will form an angle of \(84\) degrees are:

solutions.text:
At \(t\) minutes after \(7{:}00,\) the hour hand is at \(210^\circ+0.5t^\circ\) and the minute hand is at \(6t^\circ.\) Thus \[ |210-5.5t|=84. \] The two solutions are \[ \begin{aligned} t&=\frac{126}{5.5}\approx22.91,\\ t&=\frac{294}{5.5}\approx53.45. \end{aligned} \] To the nearest minute, the times are \(7{:}23\) and \(7{:}53.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: At \(t\) minutes after \(7{:}00,\) the signed separation of the hands is \(210^\circ-5.5t^\circ\)
